summary: Positions 59-116 (58 entries): Haiku had 35 photo, 13 unsure, 10 skip. Accepted 18 of the 35 keeps (11 of them with field fixes, 1 with a better first photo: Twenty-Six Martyrs); rejected 17 (ordinary types with no design reason in the lead, prizes only in the awards field, builders named as architects, unsupported claims). Ordinary among the accepted: 5 (73, 77, 99, 100 and the civic 64), 28% of these 18; each has a design reason in its lead, but the pool is over the 20% line, so drop 64 and 99 first if the whole batch needs trimming. Rescued 0: all 23 unsure and skip entries confirmed (no usable main photo, empty lead, demolished, or not a building).
